prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return CommonJS module solution.js.
Required API: exports.encodeCsvField = function(value)
Behavior: Serialize one RFC-4180-style field. Return it unchanged unless it contains comma, double quote, CR, or LF; then surround it with double quotes and double every embedded double quote.
Visible example: The value a,"b becomes "a,""b" (including the surrounding quotes).

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
